basics.name: Markus Vainikka
basics.label: Senior Software Developer and Architect
basics.summary:
With 25+ years in software engineering across Finland and abroad, Markus has delivered high-impact solutions in automotive, healthcare, and industrial settings.

A master of the Microsoft stack, he codes fluently in .NET / C# and JS/TS, pairing them with React, Node.js and cloud-native services on both Azure and AWS to build resilient full-stack products.

Beyond hands-on development and architecture, Markus moves effortlessly between team leadership, facilitation, project management and SEO-driven growth, translating business challenges into elegant technical wins.

Calm, approachable and relentlessly supportive, he slips into any role the moment the team needs it, mentoring colleagues in agile best practices and inspiring them to achieve standout results.
